description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) enhancement AURIFEROUS ORB (Emissaries Imperatus, WP-C46): the bearer has the Auriferous Orb ranged weapon (12" A3 BS2+ S1 AP0 D1 [ANTI-NON-MONSTER/VEHICLE 2+] [BLINDING LIGHT] [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]); BLINDING LIGHT: when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by the Orb — its attacks have -1 to hit until the start of your next turn. Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2); setup privileges: P1 detachment Emissaries Imperatus, the Shield-Captain on Dawneagle Jetbike given the Auriferous Orb through the list-build pass and moved within 12" of the Gretchin, CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation, seeded dice; the Shooting phase is re-entered so the shooter list sees the new position. A real click selects the Jetbike, Quick-Assign at the Gretchin, Confirm, resolve: the Orb hits; the unit_has_shot window shows the free BLINDING LIGHT card; a real click opens the picker listing the Gretchin; a real click flags them (-1 to hit).

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Emissaries Imperatus"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
var u = GameState.state.units["U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_JETBIKE_A"]
u.meta["enhancements"] = ["Auriferous Orb"]
load("res://scripts/codex/custodes/CustodesEnhancements.gd").apply_list_build("U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_JETBIKE_A", u)
u.models[0]["position"] = {"x": 1000.0, "y": 1900.0}
tree.current_scene._recreate_unit_visuals()
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(8)
var names = []
for w in u.meta.weapons:
	names.append(str(w.get("name", "")))
return "Auriferous Orb" in names

steps.comment: the Auriferous Orb is among the declared weapons
the Gretchin's attacks now carry -1 to hit (Blinding Light) against the Custodes
